results.title: Russia Sends Il-76 Heavy Transport Plane and Six Military Helicopters to African Ally Mali — UNITED24 Media
results.snippet:
According to an official statement released by Mali’s Armed Forces on November 17, the aircraft were formally handed over during a ceremony at Modibo Keita International Airport in Bamako.

The delivery includes one Il-76TD heavy transport aircraft designed to carry personnel and cargo, four Mi-8 helicopters used for troop transportation and logistical operations, and two Mi-24 attack helicopters
